items.title: The gut-check questions every leader needs to ask before building with AI
items.summary: AI has made it easier than ever to build. It hasn’t eliminated the need to choose where you should. I’ve sat on both sides and know it's not an easy call.

items.title: Software Stocks Slip as Meta Becomes Competition
items.summary: Software companies just got new competition: Mark Zuckerberg's company is launching a business focused on selling its AI tools to enterprise customers. That's putting shares in the sector under pressure: The S&P 500 Software industry index is down nearly 2%.
